capabilities.body: I-OpenAmer icwangcisa umsebenzi, iwuqhube ngezixhobo zokwenene — itheminali, isikhangeli, iifayile, ikhowudi — ize igcine okusebenzileyo.
capabilities.title: Iarhente ecinga kunye nawe

capabilities.body: Iincoko, inkumbulo neemodeli zigcinwa kulo matshini. Akukho nto ilayishwayo ngaphandle kokuba uyicele.
capabilities.title: Izixhobo zakho, idatha yakho

capabilities.body: Iilwimi ezili-186, nganye ibhalwe ngendlela oyifundayo. Isikrini sokuqala se-app sikubuza ukuba ukhetha oluphi.
capabilities.title: Ulwimi lwakho, ngendlela eyiyo

capabilities.body: Izakhono zigcinwa kumsebenzi ngokwawo, ngoko imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla ithatha ixesha elincinane okukhona uyisebenzisa.
capabilities.title: Ubuchule obukhulayo

help: Jonga ukuba lo matshini uyakwazi na ukufikelela kwi-intanethi.
Qhuba useto kwakhona — amanyathelo agqityiweyo akaphindwa.
Ukuba iyasilela kabini, vula iilog; imigca yokugqibela ichaza inyathelo.
failure.lead: Akukho lutshintsho lubuyiselwe umva ungaxelelwanga — i-OpenAmer ima apho ime khona, ukuze ukuqhubeka kwakhona kuqale apho.
failure.leadUpdate: I-OpenAmer isekwinguqulelo yangaphambili kwaye iyaqhubeka isebenza. Akukho nto itshintshwe ngokuyinxenye.
failure.title: Useto alugqitywanga

language.lead: Useto luya kuqhubeka ngolwimi olukhetha apha. Ungalutshintsha kamva kwi-app.
language.title: Khetha ulwimi lwakho

progress.lead: Useto lwexesha elinye: i-OpenAmer ikhuphela oko ikufunayo kwaye iqwalasela lo matshini. Xa iphinda ivulwa, iyakutsiba konke oku.
progress.leadUpdate: I-OpenAmer ithatha indawo yenguqulelo yangaphambili. Iiseshoni zakho, inkumbulo neesetingi azichatshazelwa.
progress.title: Kusetwa i-OpenAmer

cards.body: Vula i-app uze uchaze into ofuna yenziwe. I-OpenAmer isebenza ngasemva ize ikunike ingxelo.
cards.title: Qala ngesivakalisi

cards.body: Iisetingi → Umboniso → Ulwimi. Kukho iisetingi zolwimi nezommandla ezili-186, ungazitshintsha nanini na.
cards.title: Khetha ulwimi lwakho

cards.body: Umsebenzi ophindaphindwayo uba sisakhono — kwixesha elizayo uthatha umyalelo omnye.
cards.title: Yivumele ikhumbule

success.lead: Yonke into ilungile. I-OpenAmer yeyakho ngoku — kulo matshini, ngolwimi lwakho.
success.title: I-OpenAmer ilungile

bullets: Isebenza kwalapha — iincoko zakho zihlala kulo matshini
Iilwimi ezili-186, kuquka indlela yokubhala oyifundayo
Yonke into ingatshintshwa kamva; akukho nto isisigxina
welcome.lead: Iarhente yakho. Kwizixhobo zakho. Ngolwimi lwakho.
welcome.leadUpdate: I-OpenAmer entsha ilungile. Ithatha indawo yenguqulelo yangaphambili ize igcine zonke iiseshoni neesetingi.
welcome.title: Wamkelekile kwi-OpenAmer
